column5: the helper itself: a Clone of http.DefaultTransport with Proxy set to nil on the next line; every production client takes its transport from here (or from externalurl.GuardedTransport, built on it)
the vendored module's own no-proxy transport (a separate module cannot import internal/httpguard): a Clone of http.DefaultTransport with Proxy set to nil (patch 0009, PROVENANCE.md)

dho push runs on the customer's machine and sends to the hosted ingest URL the customer configured; it honours HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY on purpose, as the Python httpx client it ports did (trust_env, Go port refusal parity); redirects are refused (CheckRedirect returns http.ErrUseLastResponse)
dho push (customer machine, deliberate environment proxy as above): asks ProxyFromEnvironment only to shape the request URL for a proxy, it sets no transport
